Five merged PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a line containing `voidedValue` under `src` in openmrs-esm-form-engine-lib. Best first:

1. **PR #822** (O3-6030, "Keep hidden obs group members, orders and diagnoses out of submissions"), merged 2026-10-02 18:57 UTC. It changed `voidedValue` lines in the non-test encounter code (`src/processors/encounter/encounter-processor-helper.ts`, lines 270–298, which read `member.meta.submission.voidedValue` and related lines) and in its golden test.
2. **PR #826** (O3-6027, "Clear order and diagnosis submissions on every write"), merged 2026-10-05 11:52 UTC. It changed `voidedValue` assertions in `src/adapters/encounter-diagnosis-adapter.test.ts` (line 206) and comments and assertions in `src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts`.
3. **PR #842** (O3-5847, "Stop unchanged obs values from creating duplicate obs"), merged 2026-10-13 10:47 UTC. It added `voidedValue` assertions in `src/adapters/obs-adapter.test.ts` (lines 1566–1629).
4. **PR #812** ("Add tests to cover form submission orchestration", no ticket), merged 2026-09-22 19:51 UTC. It added `voidedValue: null` lines in `src/processors/encounter/encounter-form-processor.test.ts` (line 34) and `src/provider/form-factory-helper.test.ts` (lines 49 and 57).
5. **PR #787** ("Add golden schemas for encounter payloads", no ticket), merged 2026-08-20 19:59 UTC. It added `voidedValue` assertions and comments in `src/adapters/obs-adapter.test.ts`'s sibling `src/processors/encounter/encounter-payloads.golden.test.ts` (lines 474, 1075, 1190–1191, 1227).

Each commit in the search was a squash merge on the default branch, and each PR's merge commit is verified. I searched `HEAD` (the default branch), not an explicit pinned head, because the pinned head wasn't given. The commit-date search window was `after 2026-04-16`. The search returned no truncation, so nothing in that window was missed. The `grep` over `src` shows that `voidedValue` also appears in older code, but those lines were not added or removed in this window, so they are not counted.
